elements.element: The covered matters under Vendor's defense and indemnity must be third-party claims.
elements.evidence: The clause applies HDI's obligations to “any third-party claim.”

elements.element: Vendor must defend Customer against covered claims.
elements.evidence: HDI must “defend” the Company.

elements.element: Vendor must indemnify Customer for losses arising from covered claims.
elements.evidence: HDI must indemnify the Company against the claims and all resulting damages, costs, expenses, and reasonable attorneys' fees.

elements.element: Customer's affiliates must be protected by Vendor's defense and indemnity.
elements.evidence: The protected parties expressly include “the Company and its affiliates.”

elements.element: Covered claims must include allegations that Vendor's services or deliverables infringe or misappropriate intellectual property rights.
elements.evidence: Subsection (a) covers allegations that services or deliverables provided by HDI infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right.

elements.element: Covered claims must include claims arising from Vendor's breach of law.
elements.evidence: Subsection (b) covers “HDI's breach of applicable law.”

elements.element: Covered claims must include data breaches caused by Vendor.
elements.evidence: Subsection (c) covers unauthorized access to or disclosure of Company data or Confidential Information caused by HDI.

elements.element: Covered claims must include claims arising from Vendor's gross negligence or willful misconduct.
elements.evidence: Subsection (d) expressly covers HDI's gross negligence or willful misconduct.

elements.element: The indemnified party must provide notice of a covered claim.
elements.evidence: The indemnified party must give the indemnifying party written notice of the claim.

elements.element: The indemnifying party must control the defense of a covered claim.
elements.evidence: The indemnifying party is expressly given control of the defense.

elements.element: The indemnifying party must control settlement of a covered claim.
elements.evidence: The indemnifying party is expressly given control of settlement.

elements.element: The indemnified party must provide reasonable cooperation in the defense.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly requires reasonable cooperation in the defense.

elements.element: Customer must indemnify Vendor for third-party claims arising from Customer-provided content.
elements.evidence: The Company must indemnify HDI against third-party claims arising from Content provided by the Company.

elements.element: Customer must indemnify Vendor for third-party claims arising from Customer's breach of law.
elements.evidence: The Company must indemnify HDI against third-party claims arising from the Company's breach of applicable law.

elements.element: Customer must have no indemnity triggers other than Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law.
elements.evidence: The operative Customer indemnity lists only Company-provided Content and the Company's breach of applicable law.

elements.element: Vendor must indemnify Customer against third-party intellectual-property infringement or misappropriation claims concerning Vendor's services or deliverables.
elements.evidence: Subsection (a) provides an HDI indemnity for third-party claims alleging that HDI-provided services or deliverables infringe or misappropriate intellectual property rights.

elements.element: Vendor's IP indemnity must exclude claims caused by Customer modifications.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no exclusion for modifications made by or for the Company.

elements.element: Vendor's IP indemnity must exclude claims caused by combinations with items not supplied or approved by Vendor.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no combinations exclusion.

elements.element: Vendor's IP indemnity must exclude claims arising from compliance with Customer-provided specifications.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no exclusion for Company-provided specifications.

elements.element: Vendor must provide a remedy to procure the right for Customer to continue using the affected services or deliverables.
elements.evidence: No procurement-of-rights remedy is included.

elements.element: Vendor must provide a remedy to modify the affected services or deliverables so they are non-infringing.
elements.evidence: No modification remedy is included.

elements.element: Vendor must provide a remedy to replace the affected services or deliverables with non-infringing alternatives.
elements.evidence: No replacement remedy is included.

elements.element: Vendor must provide a refund remedy if the affected services or deliverables cannot be procured, modified, or replaced.
elements.evidence: No refund remedy is included.

elements.element: Vendor's IP indemnity liability must be subject to a super-cap of three times annual fees.
elements.evidence: The rendered language contains no indemnity cap or three-times-annual-fees super-cap.

result.reason: The operative clause satisfies every preferred requirement, including the four Vendor indemnity triggers, affiliate coverage, reciprocal Customer indemnity limits, and notice/control/cooperation procedures. It does not satisfy the fallback because all stated IP exclusions, infringement remedies, and the 3× annual-fees super-cap are absent. The redline is not minimal because it additionally imposes a defense obligation on the Company, adds hold-harmless language, and extends HDI's IP coverage to the Site independently of whether the Site was provided by HDI. The original warranties remain operative and no direct contradiction is introduced, although the new indemnity provision would be cleaner as a separately numbered section.
